prompt: Flat vector illustration in the style of a modern children's English textbook: simple geometric shapes, bold flat solid colors, at most one flat darker shadow tone per object, clean smooth edges with no outlines or only very thin dark outlines, rounded friendly forms, no texture, no gradients, no watercolor, no paper grain, no photo-realism, no 3D render. No text, no letters. Do NOT draw any speech bubbles, thought bubbles or empty white balloons of any kind. Scene: Behind an old wooden school garden shed, a brave little white rabbit in green rain boots and a careful little hedgehog crouch in the grass, discovering a tiny round wooden door at the base of the shed wall, half hidden by ivy. Bun is a small white rabbit standing on two legs, one long ear flopped down, green rain boots, brave smile. Hedgie is a small hedgehog standing on two legs, soft spikes with one tiny flower stuck in them, curious cautious eyes.
